text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days before the Takarazuka Kinen, 
Sakura Chiyono O was making her final 
adjustments with the help of Maruzensky, 
whom she deeply admired.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Sakura Chiyono O say she was able 
to return thanks to having rivals, 
Maruzensky smiles and congratulates her on 
entering the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen had arrived. As 
Mejiro Ardan and the others celebrated the 
trio's reunion, Inari One—who had been on 
a sensational streak lately—appeared 
before them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One declared war on Mejiro Ardan and 
the others all at once, but from her sheer 
presence, Mejiro Ardan sensed it wasn't an 
empty boast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, not a single one among Mejiro 
Ardan and the others feared Inari One. 
Rather, their hearts leaped at the 
encounter with a formidable rival as they 
headed into the race.
